translations.web: If you forgive anyone’s sins, they have been forgiven them. If you retain anyone’s sins, they have been retained.”
translations.bsb: If you forgive anyone his sins, they are forgiven; if you withhold forgiveness from anyone, it is withheld.”
translations.kjv: Whose soever sins ye remit, they are remitted unto them; and whose soever sins ye retain, they are retained.
translations.asv: whose soever sins ye forgive, they are forgiven unto them; whose soever sins ye retain, they are retained.
